The game will be reinstalled with haptics. Its internal saves, unless in the cloud, will be lost. Android/data and Android/obb are kept and restored.\n\nThe original stays in xems-vr-out/original/%1$s — it puts the game back as it was.
The headset and the game are found by themselves — then press the green button.
Termux connects the headset, pulls the game, injects the layer, signs and reinstalls it. Usually 1–3 minutes.
Progress is shown in Termux. The result comes here when it ends.
Open the workout on the tablet, start the row and launch the game on the headset.
Something in the fields is off
Check the IP addresses and the game name.
Same Wi-Fi? After a headset reboot, plug it into the tablet once with a cable.
Put the headset on, accept “Allow USB debugging” and press again.
The reason is in the last lines below. The original game stays on the headset.
Termux does not accept commands from other apps yet. One line in Termux fixes it — copy it with the button, paste, Enter.
Scanning the Wi-Fi for a Quest with adb on. A few seconds.

If the headset asks “Allow USB debugging” — accept.
Install the game on the headset and try again.
Game picked — press the green button.
python, java, adb, git and the XEMS VR files.
Installing python, java, adb and git and fetching the XEMS VR files. First time 5–10 minutes, needs internet.
Termux is not set up yet
Press “Set up Termux” — everything installs by itself.
No Wi-Fi — connect the tablet to the headset\'s network
Copy the line and open Termux
Line copied — paste it in Termux, press Enter, then come back
Install Termux (F-Droid) and the ems/ folder inside it — see README.
Allow “Run commands in Termux” in the app settings.
Turning on adb over Wi-Fi. If the headset shows "Allow USB debugging" — Always allow + Allow.
Unplug the cable — looking for the headset on the Wi-Fi.
The headset did not allow the link
Put the headset on, accept "Allow USB debugging" (Always allow) and plug the cable in again.
Unplug and plug the cable in again. Is developer mode on in the headset?
Plug the cable in again and press OK when the tablet asks about the headset.
\? %1$s — not a VR game or not recognised
%1$s runs on Meta\'s old VrApi — haptics hook into OpenXR games only. Pick a game with ✓.
Not recognised as an OpenXR game — it may not work. Press the green button to try.
🎮 Catalog — get a game that works
Games outside the store that work with the haptics.
Pick a game — it is downloaded, gets the haptics and goes onto the headset.
The tablet downloads it, adds the haptics with the tablet IP and installs it on the headset. 1–3 min.
This game downloads only from its page (↗). The browser opens — press Download there. Then come back and press "Install" — the tablet finds the file in Downloads.
Download → haptics → install on the headset. 1–3 minutes.
The game is on the headset with the haptics. Start the row on the tablet and launch the game.
In the browser press Download (Meta Quest APK). When done — press "Install" below.
Once: allow Termux to access files.
Termux asks — press Allow. Then come back here.
